build_start_service_discovery: build a ZMQ service discovery server that listens for prefill and decode instance registrations on a given hostname and port
create_listen_for_register: create a ZMQ router listener that processes prefill and decode instance registration messages with heartbeat expiry
run_forward_request: run an async HTTP forwarder that streams chunked responses from prefill and decode vLLM instances

summarize_random_uuid: summarize the random UUID generator utility that returns a hex-encoded UUID string
